Title: Service Bus and Event Hubs Availability Zones now generally available (GA)

Body.Content:
Availability Zones is a high availability offering that protects applications and data from datacenter failures. Availability Zones support for Azure Service Bus Premium and Azure Event Hubs Standard has been added for these regions:

  • East US 2 
  • West US 2 
  • West Europe 
  • North Europe 
  • France Central 
  • Southeast Asia 

Availability Zones support is now generally available for Azure Service Bus premium and Azure Event Hubs standard in every Azure region that has zone redundant datacenters. Note that this feature won’t work with existing namespaces—you will need to provision new namespaces to use this feature.
